summary: Surveyed all 64 listed Lean files under SphereEversion/ in the leanprover-community__sphere-eversion checkout (sizes 304 to 49074 bytes) and counted declaration keywords per file: 1240 in total, 63 of 64 files have at least one theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/abbrev/example declaration. The one file with none, SphereEversion/Notations.lean, was read completely and defines project notation (𝒞, hull, D, ∀ᶠ x near s, ⬝) used across the development, which is a searchable interface. No build config, scripts, or generated files are in the unit. All files stay in the primary index as differential-topology formalization (one-jet bundles, h-principles, loops, immersions, sphere eversion) and supporting ToMathlib lemmas.
